name: Stormbringer: Amped Flow gives Shock a chain target while Stormflow channels (#3637)
contract: #3637: Amped Flow (806411) reads 'While channeling Stormflow, your Shock now strikes ${$567556m1-1} additional target at ${$804020f1*100}% value'. Its only effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL -> 567556 on TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, but 806411 has ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skips it (src/server/game/Spells/SpellMgr.cpp:2257) and nothing ever applied 567556. The payload is native once applied: 567556 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER with EffectMiscValue 17 = SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS (src/server/game/Spells/SpellDefines.h:93), EffectBasePoints 1 / DieSides 1 = 2, and EffectSpellClassMask (2048, 131200, 0) which covers Shock (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 2048) and Brine (SpellFamilyFlags[1] 128); Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets reads it, and the 75 % falloff is Shock's own EffectDamageMultiplier 0.75. Shock's EffectChainTarget is 0, so the modifier is queried against base 0 and must read 2 only while the channel runs. The buff is bound to the Stormflow channel aura rather than to its own DurationIndex 571 = 5500 ms, which would lapse 2500 ms before the 8000 ms channel (SpellDuration 31) ends. Stormflow is cast as rank 572867 and Shock is the rank 504634 a level-80 Stormbringer owns; the base id 804020 is asserted too because the tooltip names it. The additional hit itself is not asserted: Shock cast during the channel still interrupts it, since base Stormflow's own 'Shock can be instantly cast while channeling' clause rides on aura 353 and is a separate, unreported gap.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
BASELINE: Shock has no chain target out of combat (SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS on base 0)
BASELINE: the base Shock id has no chain target either
SETUP: the baseline Stormflow channel is running
BASELINE: channelling alone applies no Amped Flow buff
BASELINE: channelling alone gives Shock no chain target
Let the 8000 ms channel run out
SETUP: Amped Flow is an active passive
SETUP: Amped Flow grants nothing outside the channel
SETUP: the second Stormflow channel is running
DISCRIMINATING: the channel applies the Amped Flow buff 567556
DISCRIMINATING: Shock gains one chain target during the channel (567556 base 1 + die 1 = 2)
DISCRIMINATING: the base Shock id gains the same chain target
The buff is bound to the channel, not to its own 5500 ms duration
Let the 8000 ms channel run out
The Amped Flow buff ends with the channel
Shock loses the chain target when the channel ends
